description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E score for different large language models under varying conditions. The horizontal axis represents the model, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-13B” and “LLaMA-2-70B” in that order, and a gray bar representing “no SFT”. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-E (%)”, represents the score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  Four bars are present for each model, representing different training conditions: “no SFT” (light yellow), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink). For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 28%, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 29%, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 41%, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 43%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 5%, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 26%, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 40%, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 47%. The bars are arranged in groups of four, one group for each model, and are not visually emphasized or sorted in any apparent order.
